content.text:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting below groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
**"What you will need on day one."**: **Mandatory** (Python, SQL)

- **"need"** marks these as requirements, not preferences.
- **"on day one"** means you're expected to have them when you start, not learn them on the job.

**"What would make you stand out."**: **Optional** (Grafana, technical writing)

- **"would"** is conditional, so these are hypothetical extras rather than expectations.
- **"stand out"** means these set you apart from other candidates who already meet the baseline. They're bonuses, not requirements.

The headers avoid the usual labels like "Required" and "Preferred," but the contrast between "you will need" and "would make you stand out" maps directly onto must-have versus nice-to-have.
